capabilities: Switch between editable versions in the same workspace leaf via edge tabs
Present a version series as one topic in the File Explorer
Add, remove, and rearrange version relationships in a staged manager
Link to a whole topic or to one exact version
Aggregate backlinks across all resolvable versions in a topic
disambiguation: Not Git or file-history version control; every version is an ordinary independent vault file that stays editable and intact if the plugin is removed.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.4+; physically tested only on macOS and iPadOS, with Windows, Linux, and Android untested. MIT licensed, runs locally with no network requests or account, and the interface is available in English, Simplified Chinese, Danish, and Japanese.
motivation: The author wanted to keep layers of notes about the same idea (first intuition, practice-learned experience, later expressions) visible side by side instead of compressing them into one final text.
problem: Obsidian shows each note as a single file, so keeping several evolving expressions of the same topic means juggling separate files with no way to open or manage them together.
summary: Version-management plugin that groups multiple editable files as one topic, with edge tabs to switch versions and a staged manager for relationships.
